notes.title: Demo leak! 🎮🔥 I’ve been hard at work on the standalone demo.
notes.content:
[p]I really want to give you an exciting demo, but I don’t want to spoil the story 😅 So it’ll only be a standalone version, [b]connected to the story world[/b] but revealing none of the big secrets. The location isn’t neutral either—it’s tightly tied to the story.[/p][p]Here are 3 pictures from the making-of 📸
Take care of yourselves, and see you soon in the demo! 👀
[b]– AKNA[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/76ca3b5daafaa488e0b504b5ca5b061b6ce72bbc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/aaf7735e3678c56a67265fdbc083937c26bff12e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/df2d086533391e700469ff65294064224a713ac8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Devlog #6] – 🌍 Language Translations in Progress
notes.content:
[p]Over the past few weeks, I’ve been working on the language files ✍️, and one update has been made: [b]Simplified Chinese is currently not included[/b] in the language pack. This might change before release 🔄, but for now, I’ve focused on [b]Hungarian 🇭🇺, English 🇬🇧, and German 🇩🇪[/b].
✅ Menus, settings, and other UI elements are now [b]100% translated[/b].[/p][p]Also, [b]almost all gameplay features[/b] have been implemented 🛠️ – including the models and textures 🧱🎨.[/p][p]The [b]AI system[/b] is in place 🤖 – it will mainly react to [b]noise[/b] 🔊, and that’s how it will detect and find the player 😱.[/p][p]🧩 More updates coming in the next Devlog![/p][p]Take care,
[b]AKNA[/b][/p]

notes.title: [DEVLOG #5] 🎯 Optimization Devlog – Massive improvements under the hood!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/12ccaf9ec1e7e93b340e1d330ab3e87206d13e02.png"][/img]Today we focused entirely on performance optimization, and the results speak for themselves: [b]we achieved a huge leap forward[/b] in how smoothly the game runs.[/p][p]🔧 What we improved:[/p][list][*][p]Draw calls: [b]–57.4%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Triangles: [b]–59.5%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]GPU render time: [b]–15.2%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]FPS (framerate): [b]+47.9%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Texture memory usage: [b]–4.9%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]👉 [b]All of this was achieved without sacrificing visual quality.[/b][/p][p]🎮 The result: a faster, smoother game experience with no compromises. Thank you for following our journey![/p][p][/p][p]– Akna Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Devlog #4] The menu scene and its design are finished
notes.content:
[p]I’ve completed all parts of the menu: the layout, the scene, and everything that goes with it. I really hope you’ll like it, because I truly enjoyed creating it. 😊
Now, all that’s left is to finish the scene where the game begins, and the story intro animation or video!
I’ll check in again soon – until then, take care of yourselves.[/p][p]With respect,
[b]AKNA[/b] 🎮

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/005bdcf884a0ef5ff493e630e7473f9a7e538106.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/174683e3c181b5d8f077dd0faa1ba8777e99366c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/b00416b91ca4fbee20742ecb91d9f3833b7c1bcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Devlog #3] The menu, settings menu and the final look of the game are being mad
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]In the past weeks, I’ve been working on models and trying to create the final look and style of the game.
Currently, I am working on the menu, as well as the settings and social media menus.
Once this is done, my plan is to finish and complete the UI for the game.
After that, I will return to building the levels, and once the first part of the game is complete, hopefully I can release a DEMO.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who adds the game to their wishlist and shows interest in it.[/p][p]Have a great day!
— AKNA[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/dc6b6707efca83295e84382559856b8391ab69ac.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Devlog #2]🕯️ Developer Insight – The First Level: The Small Apartment 🕯️
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I'm currently working on the first level of the game – the [b]professor’s small apartment[/b], where the present-day storyline begins. This is where our protagonist lives in isolation, obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the mysterious deaths of his wife and daughter.[/p][p]I’ve been focusing heavily on the atmosphere: dim lighting, an old TV, empty armchairs, and a half-eaten pizza on the table – every detail is meant to suggest that time has stopped in this room. Notes on the walls, a whiteboard, and a silence that feels… too quiet.[/p][p]🕵️‍♂️ This is where the player first steps into the story – where the descent into madness and the search for answers truly begin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637728/15e3b222fb0ccda384e3d2d044ddf4c51a437313.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]What would you add to make the vibe even more unsettling?[/p]

notes.title: [Devlog #1] – The First Scene is in Progress!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

Exciting news: the first scene of the game is now in development! This is where the player first steps into the story’s world – so I’m focusing heavily on creating an atmosphere that grabs them right away. 🎮🌫️

My goal is to build a dark, oppressive, yet detailed and visually polished experience. I’m spending a lot of time on lighting, textures, and sound design to ensure every small element adds to the mood.

Progress is going well behind the scenes, and I can’t wait to show you more soon!

Thanks for following the development – more updates coming soon!
– Akna Games
